commands.name: sites
commands.description: List supported job sites and job types

commands.name: seeding
commands.description: Seed SourceSeed table from seeds/interests.md via an LLM-driven jobspy call

commands.name: approve-seeds
commands.description: For each SourceSeed name without a matching JobSource, create a JobSource (url left null) and queue sourcing on it. Run `pipeline sourcing` afterwards to discover the URLs.

commands.name: sourcing
commands.description: For every active JobSource with `url IS NULL`, ask the LLM (with web search) for the company URL, verify it by opening the page, and fill it in. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobSource regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: listing
commands.description: For each currently-queued JobSource, BFS the company site to find its job-listing page; insert a JobListSource row with a placeholder parserScript (`pipeline scripting` fills it in). By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobSource regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: scripting
commands.description: Generate and validate a parser script (listLocations + searchJobs) for each currently-queued JobListSource and store it in JobListSource.parserScript. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobListSource regardless of pipeline state. Re-scripts done rows and overwrites their parserScript on success. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobListSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: run-scripts
commands.description: For every JobListSource with a validated parserScript, ask the LLM to map the supplied (or interests-derived) division/location to the page filter options, then run searchJobs and insert the matching jobs into JobPost. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Division/department to filter by (e.g. "engineering"). Overrides the value extracted from interests.md.
Location to filter by (e.g. "Toronto, ON"). Overrides the value extracted from interests.md.
Re-process every qualifying in-scope JobListSource regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-process only the JobListSource with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: viewing
commands.description: For each currently-queued JobPost, open the URL and ask the LLM to populate title/company/location/description/salary/etc. fields. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-view every qualifying in-scope JobPost regardless of pipeline state — including ones already done / not_a_job_posting / failed. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-view only the JobPost with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: For each currently-queued viewed JobPost, score interest + skill against seeds/interests.md and seeds/cv.md and upsert the result into JobPostEval. By default only queues the selected rows; pass --start to process them now.

options.description: Re-evaluate every qualifying in-scope JobPost regardless of pipeline state. Use after a prompt change.
Also retry rows in failed / aborted / no_result state (default skips them). Mutually exclusive with --all.
Re-evaluate only the JobPost with this ID, regardless of pipeline state or qualification.
Process the selected rows now. Without this flag the command only queues them for a later `--start` or `jobfinder start-pipeline`.

commands.name: start-pipeline
commands.description: Run sourcing, listing, scripting, run-scripts, viewing, and evaluate concurrently in independent loops until every queue drains. Each loop sleeps 5s only when its previous iteration found nothing to do.

options.description: Pass --include-failed to each task on its FIRST iteration only — same picker semantics as `jobfinder pipeline <task> --include-failed`, applied once at the start so failed / aborted / no_result rows get retried. Subsequent iterations of each loop run in default queued-only mode so a fresh failure during the run is not retried forever.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export pipeline data for use outside the CLI / TUI (CSV, etc.).

commands.name: jobs
commands.description: Export fully-evaluated JobPost rows (status=Done) as CSV — i.e. only posts that cleared the in-scope filter AND have description + interestScore + skillScore + locationScore filled in.

arguments.name: output
arguments.description: Output CSV path. Defaults to ./jobs.out.csv (matches the *.out.csv gitignore so it stays out of version control).

options.description: Sort key (mirrors `jobfinder tui`).

commands.name: track
commands.description: Classify <url> via LLM as a job post / job list / neither. For a job post, enqueue sourcing on the company and viewing on the post. For a job list, enqueue sourcing and listing on the company. Exits non-zero when the URL is neither.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: URL of a job posting or a careers / jobs index page.

commands.name: tui
commands.description: Open the live dashboard. All flags are deep-link state — pass them to jump straight to a specific view.

options.description: initial tab
sort key for the JobPost tab
sort key for the Sources tab
print a one-shot plain-text snapshot of the dashboard (for agentic use) instead of opening the live view
